2147997.synopsis:
Miyu Suzuki is a bright and bubbly high schooler who’s got a crush. There’s just one little problem—when it comes to personality, the guy she’s into is her polar opposite!



(Source: VIZ Media)



Notes:
 
- Includes 12 extra chapters.

- Placed second in the Tsugimanga 2022 Award in the Web Manga Category.

- Placed third in the 16th Manga Taishou Award and seventh in the 17th Manga Taishou Award in 2023-2024.
